policy.selection: Only human text fenced file inclusions. Trim and resolve exact paths against captured workspace root, case-sensitive. Content is not compared or hashed. Newest raw source row wins; within a row greatest character offset wins, with stable first occurrence for equal offsets even across blocks.
policy.distinction: Tool READ/WRITE pruning is not implemented here. Nonhuman blocks, tool responses and failed operations are preserved by this policy; readWritePruning refuses before mutation. Independent old-array optimizer is the value oracle, not a mocked production policy.
policy.facts: Versioned namespace-scoped shared trie stores path winner row/block/offset/count and generation/header scalars. Append visits only added rows when registration/revision is ready; structural source changes rebuild; unregistered reopened append invalidates readiness until refill. Old pins retain published facts.
policy.pending: This continuous operation consumes stored raw rows; it introduces no whole-history all-paths RAM map. Existing global-ranking pending overlay remains bounded by supplied caller input, without a newly proved total pending/stale-generation capacity cap.

measurements.selectedReadBound: 6 * ceil(log2(rows + 1)) + 8; pin acquisition, initial history construction, cold fill and full operation are excluded from selected-query bounds.
measurements.chargeBoundary: Existing cache charge includes node bytes and fixed typed-array/map-slot/key overhead. Not a total cache/pin/heap bound, and not a new exact arbitrary-length path-string byte audit.
measurements.lifetimeBoundary: Actual sink argument objects tracked by WeakRef at awaited sink backpressure, unchanged bound two. Final query arrays collect to zero; retention control leaves three live selected values. This establishes object lifetime, not retained heap/string bytes or all-history-key capacity.
